title: Nodes
key_points: A node in ComfyUI represents a processing unit that takes inputs and produces outputs.
Nodes can be connected together to form graphs for complex tasks.
Each node has inputs and outputs, with types like float (numbers), int (integers), bool (boolean), image (image data), etc.
limitations: This source is a documentation page, not an original research or analysis.
asserts: ComfyUI uses nodes as building blocks for processing units.
scope: The context of this claim is the design and functionality of ComfyUI software.
